name: @kwirthmagnify/kwirth-sender-ratelimit
description: Rate limit filter sender for Kwirth — queues messages exceeding a configurable rate and delivers them in the next time window.

name: @kwirthmagnify/kwirth-sender-console
description: Writes alert messages to stdout with configurable prefix, level tags and timestamps per named config.

name: @kwirthmagnify/kwirth-sender-email-resend
description: Sends alert emails via the Resend API. Requires a Resend account and API key.

name: @kwirthmagnify/kwirth-sender-email-smtp
description: Sends alert emails via SMTP. Supports TLS, STARTTLS and plain connections.

name: @kwirthmagnify/kwirth-sender-file
description: Appends alert messages to a log file with optional rotation, timestamps and level tags.

name: @kwirthmagnify/kwirth-sender-regex
description: Routes or drops messages based on ordered regex rules evaluated against any message field.

name: @kwirthmagnify/kwirth-sender-teams
description: Sends messages via MS Teams incoming webhook.

name: @kwirthmagnify/kwirth-sender-tee
description: Fans out an incoming message to multiple downstream senders simultaneously, acting as an intermediate pipeline node.

name: @kwirthmagnify/kwirth-sender-timed
description: Routes or drops messages based on time-of-day windows and day-of-week rules.
